newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner notes private investor demand for gold.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner notes private investor demand for gold.

text.p: Private German investors have stepped up their gold buying over the last few trading days, Dresdner Bank said in a weekly market report on Friday.
The bank said the customers not only sought small bullion items and coins for use as Christmas gifts, but also bullion in the 250 gramme to one kg size.
Prices of 575 marks per ounce were up five marks on the week due to the firm dollar versus the mark.
Dresdner saw further dollar rises but recommended short-term sales at 580 marks equivalent and above since gold would not indefinitely follow the dollar higher.
The bank also saw a chance of higher international gold prices in the first quarter of 1997.
